incident-bot: PAGERDUTY P0 — eu-central-1 GPU pool: capacity_exhaustion. queue_depth x12 baseline, avg_token_latency=3100ms, error-rate +21%. paging oncall.
Jamal: ack. I'm taking lead. grabbing dashboards and recent deploys.
Priya: looking at pool status now: `redwoodctl pool status --pool eu-central-1`
Priya: ```
POOL eu-central-1: desired=10 running=10 queue=1210 avg_latency=3150ms
recent_deploys: v3-canary (2 hosts), model_mem_usage +18%
autoscaler: last_attempt=2025-01-12T02:14:05Z status=failed provider_resp=503 Service Unavailable (quota), retries=5
```
Rui: interesting — provider returning 503/429 intermittently. autoscaler backoff appears stuck in tight loop; also see repeated OOMs on a few nodes coincident with canary. can someone dump node-level metrics?
Elena: grabbing node logs: ```
[node-09] gpu_mem_total=40G gpu_mem_used=39.6G evictions=3 kubelet: OOMKill triggered on process: model-server
[node-03] gpu_mem_total=40G gpu_mem_used=39.9G evictions=5
```
Matt: that points at the canary model increasing GPU memory footprint causing reduced effective parallelism -> higher queue -> autoscaler tries to add capacity -> provider rate limits / 503s due to a simultaneous provider maintenance window. compounded failure.
Jamal: immediate mitigations: 1) revert the canary to free memory 2) manual scale attempt if provider allows 3) route lower-priority customers to fallback pool/region and smaller quantized model.
Priya: rolling back canary: `redwoodctl model rollback --model v3-canary --pool eu-central-1 --reason "memory bloat causing OOMs"`
infra-bot: action accepted, rollback job job-7891 queued.
Matt: while rollback proceeds, I'm issuing manual scale request with provider: `redwoodctl pool scale --pool eu-central-1 --instances +8 --reason manual emergency`
Matt: provider reply: 202 Accepted, but we are hitting per-account provisioning rate limits. provider note: "provision requests delayed due to regional maintenance, ETA 18-25m."
Rui: enable routing fallback now for tenants marked non-critical. `redwoodctl routing set --policy fallback:europe-west-2 --selector "tier!=enterprise" --model v2-q4`
Elena: applied. ~40% of queued jobs are now redirected within ~60s. drain rate improves for those tenants.
Priya: customer impact snapshot: tenant-spark (hosted) ~40% requests 503/timeout, tenant-ignite ~18%, tenant-ember ~7%. approx 2.2k failed requests in last 15m. CC @Sofia for comms.
Sofia: drafting status update for status.redwood.ai: "Investigating: some customers in eu-central-1 may see elevated errors and latency; mitigation in progress (rolling back canary, routing to fallback regions)." will post once rollback confirmed. :warning:
Jamal: rollback completed, model v3-canary reverted at 02:22Z. node OOMs drop off in logs, GPU mem usage normalizing.
Elena: pool report after rollback + routing: desired=10 running=10 queue=680 avg_latency=1650ms. still elevated but improving.
Matt: manual scale had partial acceptance: +4 instances provisioned, running=14. provider still throttling a subset of our requests.
Rui: additional protective step: enable per-tenant token-bucket throttle for best-effort tenants to preserve SLO for enterprise tiers. `opsctl throttle set --policy per-tenant --best-effort=200rps --enterprise=unlimited`
oncall-bot: applied per-tenant throttles; global inflight cap enabled: 1500 tokens/sec.
Priya: monitoring: queue trending down to 240 over 9m, avg latency 520ms, error-rate 2.6%. tenant-spark still showing sporadic 503s.
Sofia: posted interim status to status.redwood.ai, added note that full recovery ETA ~30m while provider finishes provisioning. :white_check_mark:
Jamal: root cause (early): model canary increased GPU memory footprint -> reduced effective concurrency -> queue growth -> autoscaler attempted to scale but provider-side provisioning rate-limited/503 during maintenance window -> autoscaler retry policy amplified requests causing further throttling and delayed scale. secondary cause: no automated rollback on OOM signal for model canaries.
Matt: artifacts to collect for postmortem: autoscaler logs (+48h), provider API traces, recent deploys and model manifests, node OOM logs, routing policy change history, customer error traces.
Elena: uploading artifacts to /incidents/6178902468/ (logs, screenshots, commands).
Jamal: action items (created): INFRA-1210: add provider-rate-limit monitoring + early alert; AUTOSCALER-346: implement exponential backoff + jitter and cap retries; RUNTIME-779: auto-rollback for model canary on sustained OOMs/memory pressure; DEPLOY-214: add smoke-test for memory footprint before canary rollouts.
Priya: also filing RUNBOOK-88: add explicit runbook step for manual model rollback when OOM pattern detected.
Sofia: customer comms follow-up drafted: status + apology + postmortem ETA 48h. ready for review.
Rui: postmortem owner: Jamal. timeline: publish initial postmortem draft within 48h, final within 7 days.
oncall-bot: handoff scheduled: Jamal -> Matt at 03:00 UTC. pinned in channel.
Matt: I'll own overnight monitoring and follow up with infra on provider maintenance schedule.
